rules.cap: 400 searched plies beyond opening: explicitly adjudicated draw, never evaluation-based
rules.draws: python-chess outcome(claim_draw=True): claimable threefold/50-move plus automatic and terminal rules
rules.failure: Crash/illegal move/protocol timeout/corrupt output: halt, retain unfinished state and full protocol logs; no automatic forfeit, no silent replay. Resume only incomplete search after investigating. Persistent engine fault -> NO VALID FINALIST.
rules.fresh_state: New processes and TT every game; retain TT within game. Full startpos opening/game history each play. Resume partial games with both fresh engines/TT, record restart; never replay saved moves.
rules.limits: Exactly80 official games; smoke excluded; no extensions, Tournament2, cleanup, engine/model/search/default changes
rules.power: AC and unchanged Acer plan required before/after every game; stop on loss/change; no settings changes
rules.statistics: 50000-draw opening-pair bootstrap (40 units, two color-reversed games each), seed2026101780; Elo-equivalent transform endpoints incl infinite bounds. Family-cluster sensitivity secondary, not pooled with old games.
rules.timing: Nominal go movetime500 for both. Wall >0.7s or reported >0.7s is hard failure; >0.55s wall / >0.525s reported flagged, retained; >1% flagged moves blocks engineering tiebreak.
rules.winner: A: paired-opening95 score CI excludes50% -> select convincing leader, absent serious reliability issues. B/C: otherwise hiddenclip if stable/correct/time-acceptable and prior throughput supported. D: persistent correctness/stability problems -> NO VALID FINALIST; never deploy.
